name: Jodie Johnson
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I am a registered counsellor with the Australian Counselling Association (Level 2). My counselling qualifications include a Diploma of Counselling (Uniting Institute of Education) and a Graduate Diploma in Counselling (UNE). I am trauma informed and support mental health wellbeing and resilience.

name: John Windschuttle
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I’m a psychotherapist and counsellor with seven years’ experience, working with trauma (including PTSD), phobias, anxiety, self-esteem, entrenched emotional and relationship patterns, men’s issues, and LGBTQ+ clients. You might be dealing with past trauma, or recognise aspects of yourself that need attention, clarity, and healing. I use a trauma-informed approach with EMDR, Flash Technique, CBT, Deep Looking, and person-centred therapy in a safe, respectful environment.

name: Joshua Samuels
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: My therapeutic approach is collaborative, insight-driven, client centered, compassionate, non-judgemental, and holistic focused on helping clients reconnect with themselves and grounded in a holistic understanding of wellbeing, addressing not only presenting symptoms, but also the underlying patterns contributing to distress. I worked with a wide range of client needs and complex presentations, supporting individuals with diverse goals, diagnoses, and life circumstances. I believe that life’s challenges can be opportunities for insight and growth, and that through greater self-awareness, people can build deeper intimacy and move forward with clarity and purpose.

name: Junko Fukuhara
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 3)
description: Hello, I'm Junko, a registered counsellor who speaks Japanese and English. I work with adults and couples to help them with mood-related issues, eating disorders, relationship issues, domestic violence/abuse and grief associated with crimes and scams. If you have private insurance like Bupa or ARHG, you may be able to get a rebate to cover a session/s with me.
